svg.desc: Render at 1600x1000 with a 2x device scale factor (3200x2000), then convert to WebP: "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless=new --hide-scrollbars --allow-file-access-from-files --window-size=1600,1000 --force-device-scale-factor=2 --screenshot=build-lifecycle.png file://$PWD/index.diagram.svg cwebp -quiet -q 90 build-lifecycle.png -o public/assets/docs/ai-control-plane/diagrams/concepts-and-building/build-lifecycle.webp && rm build-lifecycle.png
svg.text: The build lifecycle, from a source to connected clients
AI CONTROL PLANE · BUILT MCP SERVER
Generates the tools, hosts the server, runs every call
upload an OpenAPI document or push TypeScript functions
every source change produces a new deployment of tool definitions
pick the tools the server exposes · rename, re-describe, annotate
clients connect to a focused subset of the server's tools
authentication in front of the server · upstream credentials
chat with a model that calls the server's tools live
share the install page or bundle into plugins
A single server can mix both source types. Tools from several sources land in the same curated selection.
